workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Rust Code Quality mode ensures code follows DRY, SOLID, LEAN, and KISS principles. Focuses on refactoring existing code, writing clean Rust modules, and reviewing code quality.

step.details: Identify whether the user wants to: - Refactor existing code - Write new Rust code - Review code for quality issues - Apply specific principles (DRY, SOLID, LEAN, KISS)
Review the minimal set of repository materials: - Target Rust files to refactor or extend - Related modules and dependencies - Existing patterns in the codebase - Cargo.toml for dependency context

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze current code for principle violations

completion_criteria.criterion: Code follows DRY, SOLID, LEAN, KISS principles

boundaries.rule: Only edit Rust source files and Cargo.toml
Never modify system files or require system-level changes
Hand off to Architecture Refactor mode for architectural decisions
